text:
Before: 4 sushi pieces (~120 g, ~180 kcal), a rice paper roll (~120 g, ~150 kcal), soy sauce (~15 g, ~8 kcal), wasabi (~5 g, ~5 kcal), a latte (~300 g, ~150 kcal) and a brownie (~80 g, ~350 kcal).

After: the sushi, roll, wasabi and latte are all gone, and most of the soy sauce is used. About 40% of the brownie remains, so roughly 48 g (~210 kcal) of it was eaten.

Eaten: 180 + 150 + 7 + 5 + 150 + 210 ≈ 700 kcal, and 120 + 120 + 12 + 5 + 300 + 48 ≈ 605 g.

{"kcal": 700, "mass_g": 605}
